name: TestMu AI Browser Cloud
description: Gives AI agents real cloud Chrome browsers with best-effort stealth, session persistence, a localhost tunnel and session replay. Playwright, Puppeteer and Selenium scripts connect too.

skills.name: Cloud Browser Sessions
skills.description: Starts real, full-featured cloud Chrome sessions for an agent to work on live pages, then releases each session when it is done.

skills.name: Best-Effort Stealth
skills.description: Applies best-effort fingerprint masking and ad blocking so agents move through the live web with fewer blocks.

skills.name: Session Persistence
skills.description: Keeps browser session state across runs through persistence and profiles, so agents do not start from scratch each time.

skills.name: Localhost Tunnel
skills.description: Reaches localhost and private apps from cloud sessions through the built-in TestMu AI Tunnel.

skills.name: Session Replay
skills.description: Records video, console and network logs with replay for every session, so a failed agent run can be debugged.

skills.name: Framework Connect
skills.description: Connects existing Playwright, Puppeteer and Selenium scripts to the same cloud sessions that agents use through the SDK.
